_doc: Creature CR -> loot level 1..60, piecewise-linear over cr_points [[CR, level], ...] and clamped at both ends. Boss CRs reach 9,540, so the bands are log-shaped: most of the range is spent where players actually level. boss_overrides pins a specific boss resref to a loot level (Phase 4 reads it). Tune with bin/loot-sim.py.
